anchor: AOV city-tier multipliers. Scales the global per-activity AOV (data/economics/activity_aov_v1.json) up or down based on where the business sits in the urban hierarchy: tier-1 = top 20 mega-metros (NYC, London, Tokyo, Paris, Singapore, Hong Kong, San Francisco, etc.); tier-2 = next 50 major metros (Berlin, Madrid, São Paulo, Mumbai, etc.); tier-3 = the remaining ~130 cities + everything sub-metro. A Manhattan restaurant charges ~60% more per check than the global average for the activity, a Lagos restaurant ~30% less. Used by src/lib/economics/breakeven.ts to tighten the breakeven panel's typical-day AOV and orders-per-day numbers. Tier resolution comes from data/cities/city_list_v1.json when the geo slug is a known city; otherwise neutral (1.0).
